name: MongoDB Atlas
description: Managed MongoDB database service (MongoDB Atlas) and its Atlas Administration API.
notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Candidate families enumerated on 2026-10-04 from the Atlas Administration API OpenAPI specification (github-com-mongodb-openapi-e316639242) and the Atlas documentation source files github-com-mongodb-docs-24390ae37b, github-com-mongodb-docs-dedf0f9318 and github-com-mongodb-docs-a334d8d3b6, all pinned to commits of MongoDB-owned repositories. The www.mongodb.com documentation host was not reachable from the research environment, so no live page was read; the list is what those pinned files name, not a complete inventory.
